# _modpack — source of record for the mod pack

Generated 2026-08-01

One folder per mod. Each holds `source.c` (the current source, copied
verbatim) and `MOD.md` (every function, every game address, the hotkeys
and the exact build line, all extracted from that source). Rebuilding a
mod is: open `source.c`, paste, run the build line in `MOD.md`.

`mods/<name>/` keeps the full revision history. This is a curated view;
nothing here is authoritative over the source it was copied from.

## Not in the pack

| Folder | Why |
|--------|-----|
| `ai_wing_retire` | investigation notes, no mod |
| `f1cui_web_remote` | developer tool (web telemetry bridge), not a gameplay mod; 3157-line source with bundled JNA binaries |
| `red-flag-dll` | injector only, shipped separately as the pack's loader |
| `red_flag` | OWNER'S DECISION 2026-08-01 — pulled from the pack. The red flag is not a finished feature and it is invasive when it is simply present: loading the DLL repaints the blue-flag sprite red by writing 0x4D8338 inside the HUD flag renderer, binds Numpad 1/2/3 for the whole session, and can re-grid the field. It must run only when it is deliberately injected, never as part of the default pack. Source and builds stay in mods/red_flag/ and are injected by hand: mods\red-flag-dll\inject.exe mods\red_flag\redflag.dll |
| `sdk` | headers, consumed by the mods rather than shipped as one |
